learnings.title: Federal Reserve Board press releases RSS: Agencies extend comment period for proposed third-party risk management guidance
learnings.claim: Federal Reserve Board press releases RSS fetched 2026-11-14 lists as newest item: "Agencies extend comment period for proposed third-party risk management guidance" (Fri, 13 Nov 2026 21:15:00 GMT). Not independently verified.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: The finance plan should monitor the extended comment period for the proposed third-party risk management guidance to evaluate potential future impacts on vendor risk compliance while taking no immediate operational action.
